chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who falls asleep while he is in sajdah. He said: He should leave and perform wudu (ablution).

key_terms.يَنْصَرِفُ: he leaves or withdraws from the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he falls asleep while in sajdah during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning sleep during salat (prayer), specifically when a person falls asleep while in sajdah. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that such a person must leave and perform wudu (ablution), indicating that sleep nullifies ritual purity in this case.
